package catalog

import (
	"context"

	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain/repository"
)

// ListPublicScopes returns authored track-level paths available in the public catalog.
type ListPublicScopes struct {
	Scopes repository.CatalogScopeRepository
}

func (uc ListPublicScopes) Handle(ctx context.Context, lang string) ([]domain.CatalogScope, error) {
	return uc.Scopes.ListPublic(ctx, lang)
}
